appDesc.message: A cute duck swims after your mouse pointer, lets you pet and feed it, and hunts fish. With ducklings and many duck models.

chkFollow.message: Follows the cursor (off: she roams the page on her own) 🖱️

chkRandomStart.message: New random model on every browser start 🎲

achCode1D.message: The IT Duck fell asleep at her laptop for the first time — face first on the keyboard.

achCode2D.message: 10 laptop naps. The screensaver knows her by name now.

achCode3D.message: Fell asleep at the laptop 50 times. Her code runs in production anyway.

achPets1D.message: Pet the duck through 10 full petting sessions — until the hearts fly.

achPets2D.message: 100 full petting sessions — she recognizes your mouse by sound.

achPets3D.message: 500 petting sessions. Let's be honest: she tamed YOU.

achPecks1D.message: Hold your mouse still until she has pecked the cursor 25 times.

achPecks2D.message: 200 pecks at your cursor. That poor pointer.

achPecks3D.message: 1000 pecks. Maybe request a new cursor.

achFish1D.message: Her very first caught fish. She was extremely proud.

achFish2D.message: 25 fish snapped up — the pond tells stories about her.

achFish3D.message: 100 fish. The fish keep a wanted poster of her by now.

achFishEscD.message: 10 fish got away. Every single one was huge, obviously.

achCrumbs1D.message: Double-click to toss bread crumbs — 20 of them got devoured.

achCrumbs2D.message: 100 crumbs served. The bakery greets you by first name.

achCrumbs3D.message: 500 crumbs. You're not feeding anymore — you're supplying.

achBurstD.message: Overfeed her 3 times until she goes POP. Don't worry, she always comes back.

achBurst2D.message: 10 pops. The feathers have their own flight route by now.

achDance1D.message: Wiggle the cursor quickly next to her — 5 little dances danced.

achDance2D.message: 25 dances. The pond is officially a club now.

achVisit1D.message: The first visit from a wild duck — quack duet and dance included.

achVisit2D.message: 10 visits. Word has clearly gotten around.

achVisit3D.message: 50 visits. Technically you're running a festival now.

achStartleD.message: Swipe straight through her 10 times — feathers flew.

achDizzyD.message: Circle the cursor around her until she got woozy 5 times.

achDizzy2D.message: 25 spin cycles. She still sees little stars.

achPeekD.message: Rest the cursor calmly on her — played peekaboo 5 times.

achSleepD.message: Let her fall asleep undisturbed 10 times. Zzz.

achSleep2D.message: 50 naps. And every day the duck greets you again.

achNestD.message: Tuck the ducklings into the nest 5 times — mama nudges them to bed herself.

achSurfD.message: Scroll hard — the family rode the current 25 times.

achSurf2D.message: 100 waves. Your scroll wheel demands hazard pay.

achStyleD.message: Switch the duck model 10 times in the popup.

achStyle2D.message: 100 model switches. Who am I — and if so, how many ducks?

achLegendD.message: Pick a legendary duck: rainbow, galaxy, or gold.

achQuoteD.message: Listen to 10 lines from the Visionary or IT Duck. One more thing …

achWaddleD.message: Watch her go ashore 5 times — or trigger it from the popup.

achWaddle2D.message: 25 shore leaves. The waddle walk is a registered club now.

achPets4D.message: 2,500 pets. She answers to your name now — and you to hers.

achPecks4D.message: 5,000 pecks. The cursor has holes in it. We keep counting anyway.

achFish4D.message: 500 fish. The pond now has a Wikipedia article about her.

achFishEsc2D.message: 100 fish got away — each one at least waist-high in the retelling.

achCrumbs4D.message: 2,500 crumbs. You officially run a supply chain now.

achBurst3D.message: 50 pops. The feathers now come with their own weather forecast.

achDance3D.message: 100 dances. She teaches classes now — sign up at the pond's edge.

achVisit4D.message: 200 visits. The pond has rush hours and a traffic plan.

achStartle2D.message: Swiped through her 50 times. She flinches when you so much as touch the mouse.

achStartle3D.message: 250 startles. She has a therapist now — also a duck.

achDizzy3D.message: 100 spin cycles. The stars now orbit on their own.

achPeek2D.message: 25 rounds of peekaboo. She has regular hiding spots and rotates them.

achPeek3D.message: 100 peekaboos. Allegedly she was there the whole time.

achSleep3D.message: 250 naps. Quiet, please: she's dreaming of you right now.

achGold1D.message: The Tycoon Duck dove into her gold hoard for the first time.

achGold2D.message: 10 gold baths. The coins have taken her shape by now.

achGold3D.message: Slept in the gold 50 times. She counts it at night — every coin.

achNest2D.message: Tucked the ducklings in 25 times. With a lullaby, of course.

achNest3D.message: 100 nest nights. The ducklings have prepared a thank-you speech.

achSurf3D.message: 500 waves. Your scroll wheel is now Olympic-certified.

achStyle3D.message: 500 model switches. The mirror has given up.

achQuote2D.message: 50 lines. You've got front-row seats to every presentation.

achQuote3D.message: 200 lines. By now you believe everything she says.

achWaddle3D.message: 100 shore leaves. 26.2 miles — in duck steps.

achStreakD.message: Visited 30 days in a row. She has long kept a regular spot free for you.

wLead.message: From now on she swims after your mouse pointer on every website. Try her out right here.

wFeat1t.message: The farther away your cursor, the faster she paddles — wake and bow wave included.

wFeat2t.message: Let her catch up, then wiggle the cursor over her — hearts included.

wFeat3t.message: Hold the mouse still. Once she has caught up, she pecks your cursor.

wFeat4t.message: Double-click anywhere on the page to toss bread crumbs — she swims over and picks them up one by one.

wFeat5t.message: Every now and then a fish shadow passes by. She chases it and snaps — doesn't always work out.

wFeat6t.message: Circle the cursor around her a few times — she gets woozy.

wFeat7t.message: Wiggle the cursor quickly next to her — she dances along.

wFeat8t.message: Rest the cursor calmly on her — she dives and pops up right next to it.

wFeat9t.message: Swipe through her really fast — feathers fly.

wFeat10t.message: After a while of quiet (adjustable in the popup) she falls asleep. Zzz.

wFeat11t.message: Dabbling, diving, preening, bathing, pirouettes, quacking.

wCtrl1.message: Click the duck icon in the toolbar: pick a model, size, speed, ducklings, sound.

wCtrl4.message: In the way on some site? Use “Pause on this site” in the popup.

uH1.message: Your duck has learned new tricks 🎉

uLead.message: Here's what's in this update — try everything right on this page.

uF1t.message: Hoodie, headphones, thick glasses and her own laptop: when she gets sleepy she types a few lines, nods off and face-plants onto the keyboard — screensaver included. In between she debugs with a rubber duck and drops lines like “It works on my machine.”

uF2t.message: New switch in the popup: turn off “Follows the cursor” and she lives on the page instead — swims and waddles her own routes, naps when she feels like it, and comes over for a peck when your cursor rests nearby.

uF3t.message: Headphones and nerd glasses for every model, unlocked by the IT duck's laptop naps — three new badges, 63 in total.

uTip.message: Everything else as usual: popup via the duck icon, Alt+Shift+D toggles her on and off.

uTryLaptop.message: The IT duck is swimming on this page — in a moment she'll settle down at her laptop. Click her and she quacks back.

uTryRoamHint.message: Only on this page — your settings stay as they are.

wTip.message: She floats above the page but never intercepts clicks — links, text and buttons keep working as usual.
